costNotice.title: First, find out your cost per {{unit}}
costNotice.message: Without it, the calculator can't tell how much of the fare goes to the car.

offer.distanceHint: Add the drive to the pickup and the trip itself.
offer.scoreExplain: The score compares the ride with your cost and your minimums. At {{target}} or higher, it meets both minimums. Below {{belowCost}}, it doesn't cover the cost of the car.
offer.scoreDisclaimer: The score is only a guide: the decision is always yours.

quote.profitPerHour: How much you want to make per hour
quote.profitPerHourHint: This is the value of your time in the suggested price.
quote.minimumHint: A short ride can result in a very low price. If that happens, the app suggests this amount.
quote.covers: Covers the car for {{distance}} and pays {{perHour}}
